identity_windows_in_range.note: The case OTA updater's preserved SN identity windows (0x0803F000..0x0803F00F, 0x0803F800..0x0803F807, and the bank-2 mirrors at 0x0807Fxxx) are proven by g2-box-stm32g0-platform-recovery.md to lie far beyond this 55,752-byte application image (image_contains_preserved_windows: false). Zero identity-window bytes exist inside 0x08000000..0x0800D9C8; there is nothing to reconstruct or divergence-document for identity windows within this range.
